name: Reduce_risks
summary: This EA is designed to reduce trading risk by implementing hedging strategies that open opposing positions when existing trades move against the trader. It monitors open positions and automatically places counter-direction trades to limit drawdown exposure.
summary_zh: 该EA旨在通过实施对冲策略来降低交易风险，当现有持仓朝不利方向运动时，自动开立反向仓位。它监控持仓情况并自动放置反向交易以限制回撤敞口。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是风险对冲，当检测到已有持仓出现亏损时，通过开立反向仓位来减少整体风险敞口。入场条件基于对现有持仓浮亏的监控，当亏损达到预设阈值时触发对冲操作。出场条件可能包括主仓位回归盈利或对冲仓位达到目标利润后平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于原始仓位比例的方式确定对冲仓位大小。资金管理方面，EA名称'降低风险'表明其设计初衷是保护资金而非追求高收益，但多次对冲可能导致持仓复杂化。整体策略属于防御性交易方法，适合在剧烈波动市场中保护已有仓位。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is risk hedging, opening opposing positions when existing holdings show losses to reduce overall risk exposure. Entry conditions are based on monitoring floating losses of existing positions, triggering hedging operations when losses reach a preset threshold. Exit conditions may include closing the hedge when the primary position returns to profit or when the hedge position reaches its target profit. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a ratio-based approach relative to the original position to determine hedge size. Money management is defensive by design as indicated by the name 'Reduce risks', aiming to protect capital rather than pursue high returns, though multiple hedges can complicate position management. Overall, this is a defensive trading approach suitable for protecting existing positions in volatile markets.

parameters.name: HedgeTriggerPips
parameters.description: 触发对冲的浮亏点数阈值
parameters.description_en: Floating loss in pips to trigger hedge

parameters.name: HedgeLotMultiplier
parameters.description: 对冲手数相对于原始仓位的倍数
parameters.description_en: Hedge lot multiplier relative to original position

parameters.name: MaxHedgePositions
parameters.description: 最大允许的对冲持仓数量

parameters.name: CloseHedgeOnProfit
parameters.description: 是否在主仓位盈利时平仓对冲
parameters.description_en: Close hedge when main position is profitable

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于区分持仓
parameters.description_en: Order magic number to manage; 0 manages all orders

pros: 有效限制单边持仓的下行风险，在剧烈波动市场中提供保护
对冲策略逻辑清晰，无需复杂技术指标判断即可执行
半自动化设计允许交易者保留主仓位判断权，灵活性较高
pros_en: Effectively limits downside risk of directional positions, providing protection in volatile markets
Hedging strategy logic is clear and executable without complex technical indicator analysis
Semi-automated design allows traders to retain discretion over primary positions, offering flexibility
cons: 对冲仓位本身也可能亏损，若市场持续单边运行可能导致双向持仓同时浮亏
多次对冲可能使持仓结构过于复杂，增加管理难度和点差成本
缺乏明确的止损机制可能导致对冲失败时风险失控
cons_en: Hedge positions themselves can incur losses; sustained one-sided market moves may cause both original and hedge positions to lose simultaneously
Multiple hedges can overcomplicate position structure, increasing management difficulty and spread costs
Lack of explicit stop-loss mechanisms may lead to uncontrolled risk if hedging fails
improvements: 增加对冲仓位的止损设置，防止单边行情下对冲失效造成双重亏损
加入点差过滤和市场波动率检测，避免在高点差或极端波动时频繁开仓对冲
improvements_en: Add stop-loss settings for hedge positions to prevent double losses when hedging fails in trending markets
Incorporate spread filtering and volatility detection to avoid frequent hedging during high spread or extreme volatility conditions

risk_points: 对冲仓位缺乏止损可能导致双向持仓同时亏损扩大
频繁对冲增加交易成本（点差和佣金），可能侵蚀账户资金
risk_points_en: Lack of stop-loss on hedge positions may cause both sides of the position to accumulate losses simultaneously
Frequent hedging increases trading costs (spreads and commissions), which may erode account equity

summary_en: This EA is designed to reduce trading risk by implementing hedging strategies that open opposing positions when existing trades move against the trader. It monitors open positions and automatically places counter-direction trades to limit drawdown exposure.
